title: Osaka to Tokyo: Japan Classic EV Expressway Run
subtitle: A 5-day journey through Japan's cultural heartland

route.kidActivities: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Kyoto Railway Museum, Fushimi Inari Shrine
Nagoya Science Museum, Toyota Museum, Nagoya Castle
Hakone Ropeway, Open-Air Museum, Lake Ashi cruise
Tokyo Disneyland, teamLab Planets, Shibuya Sky

bestFor: Families wanting a comprehensive Japan experience with theme parks and culture
tips: Japan uses CHAdeMO — charge at expressway service areas every stop
Tomei/Meishin Expressway is excellent but tolls are expensive (~¥15,000)
Download the NCS app for finding CHAdeMO chargers
Most luxury hotels offer overnight AC 200V charging
seasonal: March to May (cherry blossom) or October to November (autumn foliage)
